name: Dawn in the Mountains

angles.text: As a priest, you can follow Father Gavin's gentler path. He ministers to travelers and tends wounds instead of wielding a weapon on the Argent Dawn's front lines.
You can aid neutral humanitarian work in dangerous mountain country by supporting an Argent Dawn shelter like Misty Pine Refuge.
The Argent Dawn accepts aid and offers sanctuary regardless of allegiance. Outposts like Father Gavin's are rare safe havens in the wilderness.

aliases: who is the priest at misty pine
faq.answer: Father Gavin is an Argent Dawn priest who tends Misty Pine Refuge in the mountains. Many in his order take up arms against the unholy, while he heals and comforts travelers and gives them shelter.
Misty Pine Refuge is a peaceful rest stop for mountain travelers. Father Gavin restored an old building in the wilderness for wanderers to recover, rest, and receive healing.
The Argent Dawn is a holy order that seeks out and destroys unholy and unnatural threats across Azeroth. It also aids those struggling to survive in troubled lands.
Holy candles replenish Father Gavin's supplies at Misty Pine Refuge. They serve religious rites and prayer, and light the refuge for weary travelers.
faq.q: Why does Father Gavin need a shipment of holy candles?

faq.answer: Father Gavin chooses to heal and shelter travelers instead of taking up a weapon. The Argent Dawn fights darkness, while he serves through compassion, hospitality, and spiritual care.
faq.q: Does Father Gavin take up arms like other Argent Dawn members?

aliases: where does dawn in the mountains lead
faq.answer: You carry a crate of holy candles through the mountains to Father Gavin at Misty Pine Refuge, helping sustain his mountain sanctuary.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the quest Dawn in the Mountains?

sections.body: Father Gavin follows the Light's gentler calling within the Argent Dawn. Many in the order take up arms against unholy horrors across Azeroth, but he heals the afflicted and tends the weary. He restored an abandoned structure in the rugged mountain wilderness and made it Misty Pine Refuge, a safe stop for travelers facing the high passes.
sections.title: A Sanctuary in the Peaks

sections.body: An isolated mountain refuge needs steady care. Father Gavin depends on charity from distant allies to sustain his ministry and keep the lamps and altars burning. A delivery of consecrated candles replenishes the sanctuary's supply, keeping it a beacon of light, warmth, and hope in the wilderness.
sections.title: Candles for the Light

summary: At Misty Pine Refuge, Father Gavin tends travelers with the Light's healing and comfort. He needs holy candles to keep his mountain sanctuary supplied.
